fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro Copy
fields.value: Register your application to request access to NCMEC missing child poster data.

fields.name: formAction
fields.label: Submit Endpoint URL
fields.description: Optional. Leave blank for the selected default submission mode endpoint.

fields.name: submissionMode
fields.label: Submission Mode
fields.description: Use backend modes for the new Laravel endpoint. Legacy AEM posts back to the original old-site adaptive form endpoint.

fields.name: notificationEmail
fields.label: Notification Email
fields.description: Optional email recipient for backend email modes. Backend only sends to allow-listed addresses.

fields.name: clientTokensEndpoint
fields.label: Client Tokens Endpoint URL
fields.description: Only used by Legacy AEM mode. Defaults to the old-site endpoint that returns generated client ID and secret.

fields.name: successMessage
fields.label: Success Message
fields.value: Thank you. Your request has been submitted.

fields.name: errorMessage
fields.label: Error Message
fields.value: We could not register this application. Please review the form and try again.

fields.name: topPadding
fields.label: Top Padding (Optional)
fields.description: Accepts CSS lengths like 64px, 4rem, or 0. Plain numbers default to px.
